document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Your once-firm steps have weakened. You are very, very weary. 
Have you wandered too far west? Can you return? 
If you succeed with a Navigate or POW roll, go to 285. If you 
fail both of these rolls, your eyesight suddenly blurs. 
Make a Survival (Desert) roll: if successful, go either south to 
255, west to 283, or, if you haven’t got a clue, go to 245. If you 
failed the Survival roll, you’re doomed! You must hope that a 
wiser, better-skilled investigator takes up the chase. As for you, 
it is ... THE END.
(246, 255, 268, 283)
